subject: Renewal: capacity uplift & payor reconciliation for CloudScale
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cloudscale.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: capacity uplift & payor reconciliation for CloudScale

Hi Elena —

We’re coming up on CloudScale’s annual renewal for the Dedicated capacity commitment (PO 78912). Per our renewal overview, the customer is planning a 25% capacity uplift starting 2028-08-01 and would like invoices routed to corporate AP rather than the original project payor.

Quick asks so we can finalize the amendment and get finance to process:
- Can you confirm the payor entity for invoicing (US entity vs EU entity)?
- Confirm desired net terms (your note earlier mentioned Net60 — confirm if that applies to the renewed commit).
- Please attach the signed PO and the appropriate tax form (W-9 for US entity; VAT cert/W-8BEN-E for non-US entity) so we can accept the change.
- Preferred invoice contact / email (if different from accounts-payable@cloudscale.com).

If you prefer, I can loop in our finance ops (Rishi) and billing lead (Marissa) to handle the split invoices. We want to avoid a delay on the go-live date for the additional capacity.

Thanks — I’ll hold on booking the uplift until I have the PO/tax docs and confirmation on net terms.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0123

Redwood Inference — Production-first inference runtime

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cloudscale.com>

Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 11:03:27 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: capacity uplift & payor reconciliation for CloudScale

Karthik —

Thanks for the note. Confirming a few items from our side:
- PO #78912 will cover the renewal + the 25% uplift.
- Invoices should be routed to our corporate AP: accounts-payable@cloudscale.com (please cc finance@cloudscale.com for visibility).
- We want invoices on Net60 for this renewal (Finance has approved Net60 for the committed amount).
- The legal/payor change is a split: the US legal entity (CloudScale, Inc.) will pay 60% and the EU entity (CloudScale EU Ltd) will pay 40% — we need two invoices split 60/40.

We’re preparing the signed PO and the tax docs. For the US side we’ll send a W-9; for the EU side we’ll attach a VAT registration certificate. I’ll upload both to DocuSign and share the link once signed.

Can Redwood generate two invoice lines referencing PO #78912 and include the split percentages? Also confirm whether Redwood needs any additional documentation (EIN for US payor or VAT number for EU payor).

Elena
Elena Torres
Director, Procurement
CloudScale Inc.
elena.torres@cloudscale.com | +1 212-555-0456

- invoices to accounts-payable@cloudscale.com on Net60.

Date: Fri, 27 Jul 2028 10:15:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: capacity uplift & payor reconciliation for CloudScale

Hi Elena / team —

Thanks for the clarity. Finance has reviewed the ask and we can support a split-invoice approach for this renewal with the following notes:

- Required docs: W-9 for CloudScale, Inc. (US) and either a VAT registration certificate or W-8BEN-E for the EU entity (CloudScale EU Ltd). Please include legal entity names and tax IDs on each document.
- Net60: Approved for this commitment level. We will treat the invoices as standard receivables with Net60 terms; please note account aging will be considered for future commits.
- PO reference: Please ensure the PO number (#78912) is present on both invoices and that each invoice states the split percentage (60% / 40%) and the equivalent dollar amount.
- Remit-to: We will send the remit instructions once invoices are generated; Marissa will set up two invoice schedules and ensure correct remit addresses on each.

Attachments we need from your side: signed PO (PDF), CloudScale_W9_US.pdf and CloudScale_VAT_EU.pdf. If you prefer, upload to DocuSign and share the link — that works for our records.

Marissa — can you prepare the two invoice templates tied to PO 78912 and confirm the invoice numbers we’ll use?

Elena — once we have the signed PO + tax docs, we’ll generate the two invoices and send that to accounts-payable@cloudscale.com for payment processing.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
